privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title is 'Global Tech Summit 2024'. Admin credentials are admin/Admin123!. To satisfy the requirements, the 'allowregister' and 'registration_captcha' settings must both be set to 'Y' (Yes). Two specific participant attributes must be created and configured as mandatory: 'Organization' and 'Job Title'. These are typically found under 'Survey participants' -> 'Manage attributes'.
